teaser: Jeremiah Grossman's php2shell post, checked claim by claim against public data and the PHP story site's evidence, with graphs.
core_idea: Four days after php2shell, Jeremiah Grossman argued the evidence shows no wave of breaches and that adversaries exploit a small set of bugs. Re-counted from NVD, CISA, EPSS, the CVE records and the PHP story site's captured evidence, most of the post holds: the timestamp is exact, NVD counts 1,394 CVEs in the window, none cites Exploit-DB or Metasploit, VulnCheck gave 25 old bugs IDs on 22 October, and no organisation has said it was compromised. Since then CISA listed php2shell and EPSS jumped to 0.9998; yearly, CVE publications more than doubled while CISA's catalogue grew by 30%.

quotes.text: No named organisation has said it was compromised through php2shell.
